name: Questions & word order
note: Questions invert subject and auxiliary: (Wh-) + auxiliary + subject + verb (Where do you live? What has she done?). In reported or indirect questions the word order goes back to normal (I don't know where he lives).

questions.q: My husband's a ______ cook.
You look nice, Anne. ______ a new dress?
We have an urgent meeting this morning. ______ when Carrie usually arrives?
questions.fs: We have an urgent meeting this morning. Do you know when Carrie usually arrives?

questions.q: When a population votes on a certain subject, the larger number of people who agree, and must equal more than one-half of the voting population, is called the ______
questions.fs: When a population votes on a certain subject, the larger number of people who agree, and must equal more than one-half of the voting population, is called the majority.

questions.q: The game of tennis was very ______ .
A- Good night! B - ______ !
How was your honeymoon? ______
questions.fs: How was your honeymoon? It was great.

questions.q: ______ is the process people go through when they are offered citizenship in a country but they were born in another country.
questions.fs: Naturalization is the process people go through when they are offered citizenship in a country but they were born in another country.

questions.q: " ______ did she marry?" "She married to John."
Which of these tenses is Present Simple? It is ______
questions.fs: Which of these tenses is Present Simple? It is He speaks.

questions.q: It seems like a lot of flights are delayed today. ______ when flight 673 arrives.
questions.fs: It seems like a lot of flights are delayed today. I wonder when flight 673 arrives.

questions.q: Tax that is calculated and dependant on the amount a person earns in a democracy is called ______ tax.
questions.fs: Tax that is calculated and dependant on the amount a person earns in a democracy is called income tax.

questions.q: Lunch is a ______ meal for many people.
It is a rule: if you ride in my car you ______ wear your seatbelt.
questions.fs: It is a rule: if you ride in my car you have to wear your seatbelt.

questions.q: New York is such a big city. ______ wherethe subway station is?
questions.fs: New York is such a big city. Do you happen to know wherethe subway station is?

questions.q: A case must be heard in a district court first. After a decision is made in that court, the case can move into the ______
questions.fs: A case must be heard in a district court first. After a decision is made in that court, the case can move into the court of appeals.

questions.q: " ______ did you go?" "To buy some new clothes."
"Where is George" "He ______ a shower."
May I make another ______ to ask you to explain the situation more clearly?
questions.fs: May I make another attempt to ask you to explain the situation more clearly?

questions.q: There are many companies that manufacture products and consumers buy them. The products that people buy are called ______
questions.fs: There are many companies that manufacture products and consumers buy them. The products that people buy are called goods.

questions.q: Please listen ______ .
Who went to Paris? John ______ .
I was wondering if you could ______ me to play the violin?
questions.fs: I was wondering if you could teach me to play the violin?

questions.q: When people or departments become highly-skilled in one area of production because they only create or produce one item or one part of an item, ______ occurs.
questions.fs: When people or departments become highly-skilled in one area of production because they only create or produce one item or one part of an item, specialization occurs.

questions.q: He drives too ______ .
______ 4 of my grandparents are still alive.
questions.fs: All 4 of my grandparents are still alive.

questions.q: Would you ______ this letter to the post office, please?
questions.fs: Would you take this letter to the post office, please?

questions.q: Within the system, ______ courts are the only federal courts that sometimes employ a judge and a jury.
questions.fs: Within the system, district courts are the only federal courts that sometimes employ a judge and a jury.

questions.q: " ______ did you go?" "By car."
This is ______ I want to be when I grow up.
questions.fs: This is what I want to be when I grow up.

questions.q: Why do you always ______ me when I try to ask a question?
questions.fs: Why do you always interrupt me when I try to ask a question?

questions.q: The government sector that supervises all facets of farming and cultivation is the department of ______
questions.fs: The government sector that supervises all facets of farming and cultivation is the department of agriculture.

questions.q: I know the Prime Minister ______ .
I really like ______ spaghetti.
questions.fs: I really like to eat spaghetti.

questions.q: What has ______ to your New Year resolution to stop smoking?
questions.fs: What has happened to your New Year resolution to stop smoking?

questions.q: The government sector that manages the construction and maintenance of roads, highways, airports and railroads in the United States is the department of ______
questions.fs: The government sector that manages the construction and maintenance of roads, highways, airports and railroads in the United States is the department of transportation.

questions.q: What happened ______ the end of the story?
I hope you're having a good time. ______ like some more tea?
questions.fs: I hope you're having a good time. Would you like some more tea?

questions.q: Jane: Sorry you can protest if you like but it doesn't ______
questions.fs: Jane: Sorry you can protest if you like but it doesn't cut any ice with me.

questions.q: After a bill is introduced and passed by Congress, it is given to the ______ who makes the final decision.
questions.fs: After a bill is introduced and passed by Congress, it is given to the president who makes the final decision.

questions.q: When ______ you go shopping last?
My ______ colour is green.
questions.fs: My favourite colour is green.

questions.q: Mike: Give it to me. Very interesting! He says he broke the glass by accident and ______
questions.fs: Mike: Give it to me. Very interesting! He says he broke the glass by accident and he's deeply apologetic.

questions.q: Within the US government, the sector that manages the protection and sustainability of natural resources is the department of the ______
questions.fs: Within the US government, the sector that manages the protection and sustainability of natural resources is the department of the interior.

questions.q: A ______ driver.
Romans, Greek and Egyptians are all ______ nations.
How much is the new car ______ to cost me?
questions.fs: How much is the new car going to cost me?

questions.q: In a ______ economy, individuals and governments own and control production together. They both decide how resources will be used, what will be produced and who will buy and use the products.
questions.fs: In a mixed economy, individuals and governments own and control production together. They both decide how resources will be used, what will be produced and who will buy and use the products.

questions.q: Everybody was very ______ about you.
"What ______ doing in you free time?" "I like watching sport on TV."
There are no problems for me because I find those questions very ______
questions.fs: There are no problems for me because I find those questions very easy.

questions.q: A lawyer that works for either the state or federal government and sometimes cross-examines a defendant is known as the ______ attorney.
questions.fs: A lawyer that works for either the state or federal government and sometimes cross-examines a defendant is known as the district attorney.

questions.q: A plane arrived ______ the airport ______ .
That's a good question but I need ______ to think about it.
questions.fs: That's a good question but I need time to think about it.

questions.q: Frank: It couldn't possibly have been me I always shut doors ______
questions.fs: Frank: It couldn't possibly have been me I always shut doors quietly.

questions.q: Usually, a political party that holds the lesser amount of seats, or power, within an existing government is called the ______ party.
questions.fs: Usually, a political party that holds the lesser amount of seats, or power, within an existing government is called the opposition party.

questions.q: " ______ is she?" "Our cousin."
You will kill yourself if you ______ stop smoking.
Could I know why the business has ______ so long to conclude?
questions.fs: Could I know why the business has taken so long to conclude?

questions.q: Individual freedoms declared in the US Constitution, such as freedom of the press, speech and religion, are known as civil ______
questions.fs: Individual freedoms declared in the US Constitution, such as freedom of the press, speech and religion, are known as civil liberties.

questions.q: Life in New York is very ______ .
I ______ forgotten to set my alarm clock, so I was late for my train.
questions.fs: I had forgotten to set my alarm clock, so I was late for my train.

questions.q: I don't know my way around yet. ______ show me the way to the bus station?
questions.fs: I don't know my way around yet. Do you think you could show me the way to the bus station?

questions.q: A person who is not a member of a police or fire-fighting department or enlisted in the military is known as a ______
questions.fs: A person who is not a member of a police or fire-fighting department or enlisted in the military is known as a civilian.

questions.q: " ______ did you buy your new jacket?" "At supermarket."
The flight ______ delayed because of bad weather.
questions.fs: The flight was delayed because of bad weather.

questions.q: When are you going to the party? ______
questions.fs: When are you going to the party? We're going right after work.

questions.q: Within the US government, the sector that supervises and directs minimum wage and employee standards that exist in the current system is the ______ department.
questions.fs: Within the US government, the sector that supervises and directs minimum wage and employee standards that exist in the current system is the labor department.

questions.q: The news is very ______ .
"Thank you so much for helping." " ______ ."
options: Not at all. Don't mention it

questions.q: He is very lucky to have got himself a ______ job.
questions.fs: He is very lucky to have got himself a plum job.

questions.q: A manufactured substance that is used to sweeten drinks and food is called a(n) ______
questions.fs: A manufactured substance that is used to sweeten drinks and food is called a(n) artificial sweetener.

questions.q: A train leaves ______ Berlin and arrives ______ Bonn in time.
______ drive me home later?
questions.fs: Do you think you can drive me home later?

questions.q: Mike: That doesn't prove anything. Actually I heard the sound of glass ______ in the night.
questions.fs: Mike: That doesn't prove anything. Actually I heard the sound of glass breaking in the night.

questions.q: When a public official is accused and then charged with wrongful or unlawful conduct, the process is known as an ______
questions.fs: When a public official is accused and then charged with wrongful or unlawful conduct, the process is known as an impeachment.

questions.q: Teachers work ______ , but they don't earn much money.
Agatha Christie ______ her husband in 1930.
questions.fs: Agatha Christie divorced her husband in 1930.

questions.q: How many people are coming to the birthday party? ______
options: I went to that new Asian restaurant
questions.fs: How many people are coming to the birthday party? We're expecting about 25 people.

questions.q: Within the American judicial ______ , there are three levels of courts.
questions.fs: Within the American judicial system, there are three levels of courts.

questions.q: " ______ did you go?" "To the shops."
Cats ______ very well in darkness.
What are your thoughts on yesterday's meeting? ______
options: I think the president will be there
I'm glad we covered the human resources issue
We should bring up the workers' concerns
questions.fs: What are your thoughts on yesterday's meeting? I'm glad we covered the human resources issue.
questions.aw: I'm glad we covered the human resources issue

questions.q: When people say they want a six pack, they want to work out their ______ muscles in order to tone their stomachs.
questions.fs: When people say they want a six pack, they want to work out their abdominal muscles in order to tone their stomachs.

questions.q: Peter's very ______ at tennis. He won the game.
______ dog is that?
questions.fs: Whose dog is that?

questions.q: ______ some change for the bus please. Thank you.
questions.fs: I would like some change for the bus please. Thank you.

questions.q: Within the US government, the sector that operates all facets concerning veterans' services is the ______ department.
questions.fs: Within the US government, the sector that operates all facets concerning veterans' services is the veterans affairs department.

questions.q: We use adverbs ______ the beginning and the end of a sentence, but sometimes ______ the middle of a sentence.
"See you next week." " ______ . "
